en.t: Mother closed her eyes in annoyance.

units.source_text: 不过，哥哥根本听不进母亲的劝告，继续骂道：“已经十五岁了，怎么还是这么不懂事呢？

en.t: But my elder brother would not listen to Mother’s advice at all, and went on scolding me: “You are already fifteen. How can you still be so childish?

units.source_text: 只不过是雏人偶罢了，有什么好舍不得的呢？”

en.t: They are only hina dolls. What is there to be so reluctant to part with?”
